findings.claim: A local signing ledger migration can commit before a later publication check, so an all-table or schema publication can expose local command state.
findings.evidence: The migration runner commits each checksummed version independently while the original publication guard was later than the signing ledger migration.
findings.suggested_fix: Reject unsafe publications before the first separately committed server migration and prove repair plus rerun.

findings.claim: An approved claim mapping is immutable, but its referenced document content can still change before signing.
findings.evidence: The approval trigger protects claim-to-document identifiers but the referenced documents row was mutable.
findings.suggested_fix: Freeze the referenced document version for approved or signed letters and require corrections to create a new document and letter revision.

findings.claim: Evidence-hook refusal and command correlation are not request-generation scoped and can be written by a late A-to-B-to-A completion.
findings.evidence: The hook keyed requests only by the case identifier, allowing a stale completion to match after navigation returned to the same case.
findings.suggested_fix: Fence hook updates by case-scope object identity and clear prior-case state immediately.

findings.claim: A successful reassessment leaves lastCommandId populated even though correlation should remain only for uncertain outcomes.
findings.evidence: The success path retained the generated command identifier after receiving a definitive server receipt.
findings.suggested_fix: Clear correlation on success, definitive refusal or conflict, and successful lookup.
